name: Mongolia
about: Naadam (July 11-13) is Mongolia's busiest week; summer (Jun–Aug) is the only realistic window for most travel, since winters are brutally cold across the whole country.
overview: Vast steppe, the Gobi Desert, and one of the world's deepest living nomadic horse cultures — plus some of the best dark-sky stargazing anywhere on Earth.
costOverview: Ulaanbaatar itself is cheap for food and transport — multi-day ger-camp and horseback expeditions into the steppe or Gobi Desert are the real, near-mandatory expense.

specialSeasons.text: The Naadam Festival (July 11-13) — wrestling, horse racing, and archery — is Mongolia's biggest national celebration and its busiest tourist week.
